learned: 2026-10-05, by hand: /blunts has 33 product cards and /pre-rolls 24, each 'series / name / spec line / description', the spec line starting with the size ('1.5g infused blunt · Flower · Live resin · Diamonds', '1g infused pre-roll · ...').
notes: One national catalog: the site says 'The same catalog, coast to coast', and /find-us/ny gives the formats with 'weights fixed across every market' (blunt 1.5g, pre-roll 1g, loose Moon Rocks 2g, mini blunts 3 x 0.7g, mini pre-rolls 3 x 0.5g). There is no NY filter or NY product list; presidentialthcnewyork.com is an SEO guide without SKUs.

Next.js on Vercel with CSS-module class names (preroll-experience-module__<hash>__artCardSquare), so the selectors use element structure only: article > div holds p (series), h3 (name), span (spec line, plus a 'gold' badge span on a few) and p (description).

No product line: the series labels (Silver Flavor, Gold Strain, Rose Gold Connoisseur, Presidential Line) appear on /pre-rolls only, /blunts labels every card 'Presidential Moon Rock Blunts', and stores never name a series. A strain's blunt (1.5g) and pre-roll (1g) are two sizes of one product, as the stores' consensus has them.

Not read on purpose: sitemap.xml lists 28 more product pages that the two listing pages do not show (blunts 24k, gods-gift, white-walker; pre-rolls 24k, crescendo, gods-gift, waui, white-walker, xj-13, xxx; nine mini-blunts and nine mini-pre-rolls), each a prose page with an h1 and a size in a sentence. The host resets about one connection in twenty (seen 2026-10-05, also by discovery with curl), and storefront.py does not retry, so a 30-page sitemap read would fail most runs. XXX and Waui 1g pre-rolls therefore come from the stores' consensus.
/products.json and /wp-json answer 403 from Vercel; the /presidential-art/* galleries render client-side and are empty in the HTML.
